# Arrowhead Forensics

> Complete forensic supplies and equipment provider specializing in crime scene investigation tools, evidence collection kits, and lab testing products.

Arrowhead Forensics supplies law enforcement, crime labs, and forensic professionals with comprehensive equipment for scene documentation, evidence collection, analysis, and preservation. The company offers both standard forensic products and custom kitting solutions tailored to specific investigative needs.

## Key Topics

- Crime Scene Investigation
- Evidence Collection
- Forensic Equipment
- Gunshot Residue Testing
- Blood Identification & Enhancement
- Trace Evidence
- Fingerprint Analysis
- 3D Scene Documentation
- Lab Testing Kits
- Crime Scene Tools
- Forensic Supplies
- Custom Kitting
- Scene Protection & Barriers
- Field Documentation
- SEM Analysis

## Crime Scene Tools & Equipment

- [Crime Scene Tools](https://arrowheadforensics.com/products/crime-scene-tools.html): Crime scene tools, gunshot residue kits, and forensic analysis equipment and barriers
- [Gunshot Residue Kits](https://arrowheadforensics.com/products/crime-scene-tools/gunshot-residue-kits.html): Gunshot residue collection kits with carbon stubs and disks for SEM testing
- [Leica 3D Scanners](https://arrowheadforensics.com/products/crime-scene-tools/leica-public-safety-reconstruction-equipment.html): Leica 3D laser scanners for crime scene documentation and reconstruction
- [Equipment Cases](https://arrowheadforensics.com/products/crime-scene-tools/crime-scene-equipment-cases.html): Pelican cases and storage solutions for forensic equipment protection and portability
- [Remote Area Lighting](https://arrowheadforensics.com/products/crime-scene-tools/remote-area-lighting.html): Portable remote area lighting solutions from Pelican and FoxFury for field use
- [Measuring Devices](https://arrowheadforensics.com/products/crime-scene-tools/measuring-wheels-for-crime-scene.html): Crime scene measuring devices including laser measures, wheels, and tapes
- [Barrier Tape](https://arrowheadforensics.com/products/crime-scene-tools/crime-scene-barrier-tape-27.html): Police and crime scene barrier tape with dispensers for perimeter security
- [Privacy Barriers](https://arrowheadforensics.com/products/crime-scene-tools/crime-scene-privacy-barriers.html): Crime scene privacy screens and barriers for scene protection and security

## Evidence Collection & Analysis

- [Blood ID & Enhancement](https://arrowheadforensics.com/products/blood-id-enhancement.html): Blood stain identification and enhancement products including Bluestar and reagents
- [Trace Evidence Collection](https://arrowheadforensics.com/products/crime-scene-tools/trace-evidence-collection.html): Trace evidence collection kits and vacuum systems for safe evidence preservation
- [Tweezers, Scrapers & Scalpels](https://arrowheadforensics.com/products/crime-scene-tools/scissors-scrapers-scalpels-and-tweezers.html): Disposable tweezers, scalpels, and scrapers for safe trace evidence collection
- [Bullet Hole Test Kits](https://arrowheadforensics.com/products/crime-scene-tools/bullet-hole-test-kits.html): Bullet hole test kits and refill supplies for rapid ballistics identification

## Scene Documentation

- [Crime Scene Notebooks & Writing](https://arrowheadforensics.com/products/crime-scene-tools/crime-scene-notebooks-and-checklist.html): Crime scene notebooks, field desks, and portable documentation tools
- [Sketching Templates](https://arrowheadforensics.com/products/crime-scene-tools/crime-scene-sketching-templates.html): Crime scene sketching templates for accurate diagram creation and documentation
- [Thermometers](https://arrowheadforensics.com/products/crime-scene-tools/crime-scene-thermometers.html): Analog, digital, and infrared thermometers for crime scene temperature measurement

## Custom Kitting Solutions

- [Custom Assembly and Kitting Solutions](https://arrowheadforensics.com/kitting): Custom forensic kits including blood alcohol, gunshot residue, and collection kits
